title: Ominous 13ft 'doomsday fish' washes up dead as eerie legend claims catastrophe could follow
title_norm: ominous 13ft doomsday fish washes up dead as eerie legend claims catastrophe could follow
snippet: A giant deep-sea creature steeped in doomsday folklore washed up dead on a beach on Tuesday, which quickly fueled claims that it was a warning sign of an impending disaster.
